SELECT table_name
                    FROM `{catalog}`.information_schema.tables
                    WHERE table_schema = ?
                      AND table_type != 'METRIC_VIEW'

SELECT c.column_name, c.full_data_type, c.is_nullable,
       c.table_catalog, c.table_schema, c.table_name,
       t.table_type
FROM `{catalog}`.information_schema.columns c
JOIN `{catalog}`.information_schema.tables t
  ON t.table_catalog = c.table_catalog
 AND t.table_schema = c.table_schema
 AND t.table_name = c.table_name
WHERE c.table_schema = lower(?)
  AND c.table_name = lower(?)
ORDER BY c.ordinal_position

SELECT tc.constraint_type, tc.constraint_name,
       kcu.column_name
FROM `{catalog}`.information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN `{catalog}`.information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
  ON tc.constraint_catalog = kcu.constraint_catalog
 AND tc.constraint_schema = kcu.constraint_schema
 AND tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
WHERE tc.table_schema = lower(?)
  AND tc.table_name = lower(?)
  AND tc.constraint_type IN ('PRIMARY KEY', 'UNIQUE')
SELECT `account_id`, `owner_id`, `age` FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`accounts` LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.column_name, c.full_data_type, c.is_nullable,

SELECT `payment_id`, `account_id`, `amount`, `ts` FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`payments` LIMIT 1000

SELECT tc.constraint_name, kcu.column_name,
       ccu.table_catalog, ccu.table_schema,
       ccu.table_name, ccu.column_name
FROM `{catalog}`.information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN `{catalog}`.information_schema.referential_constraints rc

SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT `account_id`) AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN `account_id` IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`accounts`
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT `owner_id`) AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN `owner_id` IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`owners`
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT `payment_id`) AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN `payment_id` IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`payments`
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`accounts`
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`owners`
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`payments`

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN(`ts`) as min_date,
  MAX(`ts`) as max_date
FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`payments`

SELECT `account_id`
FROM `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`accounts`
TABLESAMPLE (100.0 PERCENT) REPEATABLE (42)
WHERE `account_id` IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 10000

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col.id AS __KUMO_ID__, col.e AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, col.s AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<struct<id:bigint,e:string,s:string>>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `amount`, `ts`
FROM TMP
JOIN `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`payments`
  ON `account_id` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND `ts` <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND `ts` > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE `ts` <= ?
AND `ts` > ?

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<bigint>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `account_id`, `owner_id`, `age`
FROM TMP
JOIN `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`accounts`
  ON `account_id` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<bigint>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `owner_id`, `tier`
FROM TMP
JOIN `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`owners`
  ON `owner_id` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col.id AS __KUMO_ID__, col.e AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, col.s AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<struct<id:bigint,e:string,s:string>>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `payment_id`, `account_id`, `amount`, `ts`
FROM TMP
JOIN `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`payments`
  ON `account_id` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND `ts` <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND `ts` > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE `ts` <= ?
  AND `ts` > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY `ts` DESC, `payment_id`
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, `ts` DESC, `payment_id`

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT pos AS __KUMO_BATCH__, col AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM posexplode(from_json(?, 'array<bigint>'))
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, `account_id`, `owner_id`, `age`
FROM TMP
JOIN `{catalog}`.`{schema}`.`accounts`
  ON `owner_id` = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY `account_id`
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, `account_id`
